summary: A browser compatibility hack for ASP.NET Ajax Toolkit modal popups, targeting Safari 3 and Chrome browsers by defining WebKit agent objects.
purpose: Enables modal popups and other Ajax Toolkit features to work properly in Chrome and Safari 3 by recognizing them as WebKit browsers and configuring ASP.NET Sys.Browser accordingly.

workflows.name: WebKit Browser Detection and Configuration
steps: If present, set Sys.Browser.agent to WebKit object
Parse WebKit version from userAgent and set Sys.Browser.version

business_rules: Treat browsers with 'WebKit/' in userAgent as WebKit for ASP.NET Ajax Toolkit compatibility.
validations: UserAgent must contain 'WebKit/' to trigger configuration.
calculations: Parse WebKit version from userAgent string.
system_behavior: Overrides Sys.Browser agent property to improve compatibility.
Ensures modal popups and other Ajax Toolkit components work on Chrome and Safari 3.
exceptions: If userAgent does not contain 'WebKit/', hack does not apply.
content_gaps: No details on limitations or side effects of the hack.
No coverage of browsers other than Safari 3 and Chrome.
